item.title: Slow Death of Deepor Beel, and a Community Fighting to Survive
item.description: GUWAHATI: Guwahati’s Deepor Beel, one of Assam’s major wetlands and a notified Ramsar site, is witnessing a steady decline in its biodiversity and fish population. Environmental groups and fishermen say the changes are not sudden but have unfolded over years due to pollution, siltation, and waste dumping in and around the wetland. item.description: GUWAHATI: Dibrugarh Police have registered a case after several residents reported that pet and street dogs have gone missing from different parts of the city in recent weeks. Locals say the disappearances are unusual and widespread, and suspect the animals are being lifted and trafficked to neighbouring states for meat.
